verdict.rationale: Skyfire API keys are scoped per-agent (Buyer/Seller) and pay tokens carry committed amounts with hard balance ceilings, and KYA-gated tokens enforce identity requirements, which together give agent-level least-privilege credentials. However, this is scoped to payment/identity tokens rather than granular API permission scopes (e.g., no fine-grained action/resource-level scoping or role-based permission sets), and there is no documented per-token revocation API. missing for 10: fine-grained permission/action scoping beyond agent+amount+identity, documented revocation controls, independent/hands-on verification of scoping enforcement.
